title: Paul Éluard's mantis collection and Caillois' mantis folklore research

tellings.quote: One of his friends, Paul Elard, another of the founding surrealists, had this insane manted collection in his home.

plain: The French poet Paul Éluard, one of the founders of surrealism, is said to have kept an "insane" collection of praying mantises in his home, and his friend, the French writer Roger Caillois, studied folklore about the mantis. The writer Jason Jorjani tells Michels this without naming a source, as part of his account of the surrealists' fascination with the insect.
